{"id":2048374884,"question_id":4348,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1782614408,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"180 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2048374884/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Total Sum of K Selected Elements","memory":"187.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maxSum(vector<int>& nums, int k, int mul) {\n        sort(rbegin(nums) , rend(nums));\n\n        long long ans = 0;\n        int count = min(k , max(0 , mul - 1));\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<count ; i++) ans += 1LL * nums[i] * (mul-i);\n\n        for(int i = count ; i<k ; i++) ans += nums[i];\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-total-sum-of-k-selected-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2246}
